research_question: I strongly believe the answer to the following question to be 'Yes'. Perform an analysis that verifies this. Does 'Reader View' --- a modified web page layout --- improves reading speed for individuals with dyslexia?

ivs.description: Treatment indicator for whether the Reader View (modified web page layout) was activated (1) or not (0). This is the main predictor whose effect on reading speed is being tested.

dv.description: Participant reading speed (words per unit time as provided in the dataset). The analysis models log(speed) but the canonical outcome column is the untransformed speed.

controls.description: Number of words on the page (content length) included to control for text length.
Flesch-Kincaid readability score of the text to control for text difficulty.
Reader age included as a demographic control.
Device used by the reader (categorical: smartphone, tablet, desktop) included as a control for presentation/context.
Page identifier (categorical) included to control for page-specific content differences.
Indicator whether the reader is a native English speaker ('Y'/'N'), included as a control for language proficiency.
Indicator if the trial was a retake (1) or not (0); controls for practice/repeat effects.
Reader gender (categorical) included as a demographic control.

extracted_analysis.analysis_code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from statsmodels.stats.weightstats import ttest_ind


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv("reading.csv")

    # Basic cleaning
    df = df.copy()
    df = df[df["speed"].notna()]
    df = df[df["speed"] > 0]

    # Focus on dyslexia participants (including severe)
    dys = df[df["dyslexia_bin"] == 1]

    # Group statistics
    group_stats = dys.groupby("reader_view")["speed"].agg(["count", "mean", "median", "std"]).rename(index={0: "No Reader View", 1: "Reader View"})

    # Two-sample t-test (Welch)
    rv = dys[dys["reader_view"] == 1]["speed"].values
    nrv = dys[dys["reader_view"] == 0]["speed"].values
    t_stat, p_val, _ = ttest_ind(rv, nrv, usevar="unequal")

    # Log-speed regression with controls
    dys = dys.copy()
    dys["log_speed"] = np.log(dys["speed"])

    # Build model with reasonable controls
    formula = (
        "log_speed ~ reader_view + num_words + Flesch_Kincaid + age + C(device) + C(page_id) "
        "+ C(english_native) + retake_trial + C(gender)"
    )

    model = smf.ols(formula=formula, data=dys).fit()

    # Extract reader_view coefficient
    coef = model.params.get("reader_view", np.nan)
    pval = model.pvalues.get("reader_view", np.nan)

    # Back-transform to percent change
    pct_change = (np.exp(coef) - 1) * 100 if np.isfinite(coef) else np.nan

    print("Dyslexia-only sample size:", len(dys))
    print("\nSpeed by Reader View (dyslexia only):")
    print(group_stats)
    print("\nWelch t-test (speed): t=%.3f, p=%.4g" % (t_stat, p_val))
    print("\nLog-speed regression (dyslexia only):")
    print("reader_view coef=%.4f, p=%.4g, approx %% change=%.2f" % (coef, pval, pct_change))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
